lines.text: After three years, God sent a spirit of animosity between Abimelech and Shechem's leaders so justice would come for the seventy sons.
Gaal son of Ebed came to Shechem, spoke against Abimelech, and Zebul the governor burned with anger.
Zebul secretly warned Abimelech, who set out by night and lay in wait against Shechem in three companies.
Abimelech cut a branch on Mount Zalmon, and his men piled branches on the chamber and burned the tower, killing about a thousand people.
At Thebez, a woman dropped a clay jar on Abimelech's head, and his armor-bearer killed him with a sword.
